author: hasanthehun
text:
Hasan Piker: I will repeat one more time the age-old credo.

JUDGE ME BY MY ENEMIES.

These are enemies of mankind. These are monstrous people. They have blood on their hands that they will never be able to wash away.

We will bring them accountability.
